cues.text: On the rooftop, your Persona Orpheus hangs in the air above you: a tall, slender, machine-like figure with a lyre on its back. It breaks into glittering shards and is gone.
Yukari sits on the ground a few steps from you.
Two Shadows crawl across the roof toward you, masks set in heaps of clawing black arms. You set yourself to face them.
